senses.gloss: (foreg.) to mourn. Hithpa. הִתְאַבֵּל, Nithpa. נִתְאַבֵּל to observe mourning ceremonies, to be bound to mourn, be an אָבֵל.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 20b:9">M. Kat. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שמִתְאַבֵּל עליו מתא׳ עמו</he> over whom one is bound to mourn, with him he must mourn, i.e. one must share in the mourning ceremonies of a relation at whose death he would have to observe mourning; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Sh’mini, 1 <cite ref="A00189"><he>נתא׳</he></cite>. Pesik. Sos p. 148ᵇ; a. fr.
